author: fesregi
text:
大学の英語の発表、お題自由だったので迷わず自分のアプリ「FesRegi」の話にしますｗ
ユーザー785人、登録模擬店262店、注文19,700件、iOSは1週間で200DL数字にすると改めてすごいなと実感
英語頑張ります💪

Hello, everyone. Today, I want to talk about something I made. It is called "FesRegi." FesRegi is a free app for school festivals. It helps students sell food and drinks easily. I made this app by myself.

In high school, I worked at a food stall at my school festival. We used paper to write orders. It was slow, and we often made mistakes. So, I thought, "I will make my own app." Now, with FesRegi, students can use a computer or a smartphone as a cash register. Customers can also order from their phone with a QR code. No more long lines!

Now, FesRegi is used in many schools. Let me show you some numbers. More than 785 people use FesRegi now. More than 260 shops are registered. And students have made about 19,700 orders with this app! I am very happy about these numbers.

There is more good news. On June 29, I released an iOS app for FesRegi. It is very new, only about one week old. But already, more than 200 people downloaded it! I think many more people will use it in the future.

In conclusion, FesRegi is a free, easy, and useful app for school festivals. It helps students sell things without stress. If your school has a festival, please try FesRegi. Thank you for listening!

日本語翻訳

皆さん、こんにちは。今日は私が作ったものについて話したいと思います。それは「FesRegi」というものです。FesRegiは学校の文化祭のための無料アプリです。生徒が食べ物や飲み物を簡単に売るのを助けます。私はこのアプリを一人で作りました。 

私が高校生のとき、文化祭の模擬店で働いていました。私たちは紙に注文を書いていました。遅くて、よく間違えていました。それで、「自分でアプリを作ろう」と思いました。今、FesRegiを使えば、生徒はパソコンやスマートフォンをレジとして使えます。お客さんもQRコードを使って自分のスマホから注文できます。もう長い行列はありません！

 今、FesRegiは多くの学校で使われています。いくつかの数字を紹介します。現在、785人以上がFesRegiを使っています。260店舗以上が登録されています。そして、生徒たちはこのアプリで約19,700件の注文をしました！私はこの数字にとても満足しています。

 もっと良いニュースがあります。6月29日に、FesRegiのiOSアプリをリリースしました。とても新しく、まだ1週間ほどです。しかし、すでに200人以上がダウンロードしてくれました！これからもっと多くの人が使ってくれると思います。 

結論として、FesRegiは無料で、簡単で、学校の文化祭に役立つアプリです。生徒がストレスなく物を売るのを助けます。もしあなたの学校に文化祭があれば、ぜひFesRegiを試してみてください。聞いてくれてありがとうございました！

#個人開発 #大学生 #英語発表 #フォロバ100

author: sondesix
text:
Alongside the Reno16 Series, OPPO also launched the new OPPO Bubble.

It is essentially a small display for remote camera preview/control that can be magnetically attached to the rear side of your phone.

It is useful to see your pose and composition when your phone is placed elsewhere or when someone else is taking the photo for you.

Here’s what you can do with it:
✅ Shutter button
✅ Zoom control (with pre-determined zoom levels: 0.6x, 1x, 2x, and 3.5x, it depends on the phone model)
✅ Switch between the photo and video modes
✅ Rear camera mirror and timer/countdown
✅ Switch the preview modes from full-view and fit-to-width
✅ Adjust the brightness of the badge with 3 different levels (up to 600 nits brightness)

OPPO Bubble works effectively as a remote camera control from up to 10 metres away.

During my testing period, I really love using the OPPO Bubble as I think it is truly helpful when taking a group photo or direct my friends/family to frame the photo.

The display looks gorgeous too, as it is a 1.73” OLED panel that is bright and vibrant.

That means your wallpapers will also look stunning here, as if you’re viewing it on the phone’s screen.

Unlike other similar solutions, OPPO Bubble is very thin and lightweight, at only 7 mm thick & 27.5 grams in weight. It is also IP54-certified for dust and splash resistance.

The battery capacity itself is at 560 mAh, rated to last for up to 49.7 hours when displaying a static image or 7.8 hours when continuously displaying the camera preview.

But, I found several things that I need OPPO to fix via a software update (or for the next-gen product):
• The functions are limited to camera control and adjusting a few system settings (brightness, screen lock, and scheduled screen off).
• It would’ve been so much better if the camera app functionality is expanded, for example: LED flash control, switching to more modes, EV control, filter picking, and more.
• It would’ve been awesome if they can expand the functionality, for example: music control, stopwatch/timer, notification peeking, and more.
• The magnet on the rear side of the Bubble is not as strong as I expected, so when placed on a magnetic case, it can easily move around or rotate, which makes it a bit harder to use.
• It is supposed to work with the Reno16 Series, but none of those phones have an included magnetic case or a magnetic back cover. You have to add the magnets on your own to attach it to the back side of your phone.
• Even though the circular shape might be visually appealing, it makes the viewfinder narrower and more limited.
• I found some software issues that happened quite rarely, like how it would fail to change the wallpaper, the connection suddenly dropping, and the camera app opening slowly.

OPPO Bubble is currently supported by 13 OPPO phones (Find X8/X9 Series, Reno16 Series, Reno14/15 Series except the F models), and compatibility with other devices will be coming soon.

Also, OPPO will extend support for OPPO Bubble to iPhone X and later models, running iOS 15 or later.

The full rollout is expected to be completed by July 7 in the worldwide market.

I think the potential of this device is extremely high. With a few tweaks, refinements, and better readiness, I can assure you that it will be a successful product.

author: indieappsanta
text:
🍎Spaces Pro: $59.99 → 0.99 (Code: INDIEAPPSANTA)🍎

You know that random moment where you suddenly think:

“Wait… when did I last water the plant?”

Or take the vitamins. Or call your parents. Or replace the air filter. Or feed the sourdough starter that may or may not still be alive.

Most productivity apps respond to this by screaming at you with streaks, charts, and guilt notifications.

Just Did does the opposite.

Just Did is a calm little app built around one simple question:
“When did I last do that?”

No streaks to protect. No pressure. No “you failed your routine” energy.

Just a simple way to log the things you’ve already done and quietly remember them later.

The interaction is weirdly satisfying too:
• Tap and hold a task card to mark it done
• No checklists, forms, or clutter
• Optional reminders if it’s been “a while”
• Flexible cadences like every 3 hours, 4 days, or 2 weeks
• Shared Spaces for couples, roommates, coworkers, or friends
• See who handled what without assigning tasks or nagging people
• Personal tasks stay on-device for privacy
• Use locally without even creating an account if you want

Honestly, it feels less like a productivity app and more like a soft memory extension for real life.

Perfect for people who hate traditional habit trackers but still want some sense of order without the pressure.

How to Redeem:
Open the app and click Spaces Pro. Click Redeem Code and enter the code INDIEAPPSANTA

Once you start using it, your brain stops wasting energy trying to remember tiny life maintenance tasks all day.

This one’s surprisingly comforting.

TradeWell Research is live on the App Store — AI-ranked stock research, quant scores across 12 sectors and 8 time horizons, and full model transparency. Research only · not financial advice.

author: muhammadxwaqas
text:
After months of building, rebuilding, coding, fixing bugs, spending money, submitting…

Getting rejected.

Fixing.

Resubmitting.

Getting rejected again.

(5 rejections later…)

Social Genius is officially LIVE on the App Store. 🚀🍎

Every rejection was just another checkpoint. We kept shipping, kept improving, and refused to quit.

Now the real game begins.

Time to bring our marketing sauce, flood the internet with content, and make this thing stupidly viral.

Fingers crossed. 🤞
